title: Register Bounds in a Configuration
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a nine-register state, let $B\in\mathbb{N}$, and suppose each register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$. For any optional control label and optional Boolean result, every register in the configuration formed from that label, the register vector of $\sigma$, and the result is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Each of the nine registers of σ is at most B
replaced:
Let $\sigma$ be a nine-register record and $B\in\mathbb{N}$. If each of its nine
register values is at most $B$, then for any optional control label and optional Boolean
result, every register value in the configuration formed from that label, the record's
register vector, and the result is at most $B$.
